card_en: To ask a name, Slovenian says how is the name to you: kako ti je ime, politely kako vam je ime. Answer with ime mi je and your name.

toggles.label: Talking to
options: an older person or a stranger

quick_check.prompt_sl: Dober dan, gospa. Kako ___ je ime?
quick_check.explain_en: You say vi to gospa, so use the polite vam: kako vam je ime.

helper_de: Built like German mir ist kalt, with the person in the dative: ime mi je, the name is to me.
helper_en: English says my name; Slovenian says the name is to me. So mi, ti and vam change, never ime.
